sections.heading: 1. Factors of Production
points: Every production requires four **factors of production**:

sub: **Physical capital** — **fixed capital** (tools, machines, buildings — used many years) and **working capital** (raw materials, money in hand).
**Human capital / knowledge and enterprise** — those who combine the other three.

sections.heading: 2. Farming in Palampur
points: **Land is fixed** — since 1960 there has been **no expansion** of cultivable land in Palampur.
To grow more on the same land, farmers use **multiple cropping** (growing more than one crop a year) and **modern (HYV) farming**.
**Green Revolution** — **HYV seeds** + **irrigation (tube wells)** + **chemical fertilisers, pesticides** + **machinery** raised yields greatly (esp. wheat).
Modern inputs need **more water and capital**; overuse of chemicals/groundwater harms the soil and environment.

sections.heading: 3. Labour, Capital and Distribution
points: **Landless labourers** work on others' fields for **low wages** (often below the minimum wage due to competition).
**Farmers with little land** may borrow at **high interest** from moneylenders/large farmers.
**Surplus** produce is sold in the **market**; the money is used as **capital** for the next cycle.
Large farmers have **their own savings** as capital; small farmers must **borrow**.

sections.heading: 4. Non-Farm Activities
points: Only ~**24%** of Palampur's working people are in **non-farm** activities.
Examples: **dairy, small manufacturing, shopkeeping, transport**.
Expanding non-farm work is important to provide **more employment** in villages.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Four factors: land, labour, physical capital (fixed + working), human capital.
Land is fixed → multiple cropping + HYV modern farming to grow more.
Green Revolution = HYV seeds + irrigation + fertilisers + machinery (raised wheat yields).
Fixed capital (tools/machines) vs working capital (raw materials/money).
Small farmers borrow capital (high interest); large farmers use their own savings.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Multiple cropping** = growing more than one crop on the same field in a year.
**Fixed capital** = tools/machines/buildings; **working capital** = raw materials & money in hand.
The **Green Revolution** relied on **HYV seeds + irrigation + fertilisers**.
Land in Palampur is **fixed** — output grows only through better methods, not more land.
